narrative.overview: A local secrets workspace with shared navigation and compact, platform-aware controls. DESIGN.md explains component reuse and interaction rules; source tokens and shared components own exact values.
keyCharacteristics: 208px expanded navigation and 64px rail shared across Home, Project, and Access Logs.
One saved sidebar choice and shared native zoom across workspace navigation.
24px headings, 13px controls, 12px metadata, and 16px default interface icons.
System interface font and native materials on macOS; bundled Geist and shared theme elsewhere.
Masked credentials, explicit approval, and evidence-backed metadata.
dos: Reuse existing shared components and Tailwind utilities; adapt shadcn/Radix when a control is missing.
Use semantic theme tokens and shared controls.
Respect platform light/dark themes and accessibility fallbacks.
Preserve keyboard focus, translations, and explicit import review.
donts: Do not overlap count bubbles on collapsed icons.
Do not invent credential validity, deployment, or identity metadata.
